name: nestprep-functions
description: NestPrep Cloud Functions — only what Firestore Security Rules cannot express (foundation ADR-0002).

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --project demo-nestprep
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-nestprep --config ../firebase.json "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules
